resources.string: Shows what is playing and lets you control it

Realme phones stop apps in the background to save battery. To keep videos playing when you go to the home screen or lock your phone:

1. Tap "Allow" on the next screen (battery optimisation).
2. Then in App info → Battery, choose "Allow background activity".
3. Optional: in Recents, lock FreeView (padlock icon).
Next: in App info → Battery, allow background activity.
